title: solutions-pro-services-weekly-sync-notes-2026-06-16
body:
Date: 2026-06-16
Time: 10:00–10:45 PT
Attendees: Asha, Mateo, Priya, Liam, Jinwoo, Thomas (customer success, joined for Senta), Rahul (on-call for Dedicated infra)
Absentees: Zoe (out)

Agenda:
- Quick round-robin customer status (30m)
- Blockers and escalation items (10m)
- Action items and owners (5m)

Notes / Customer updates:
1) Senta (Enterprise banking) — on Dedicated
- Current phase: internal integration + compliance checklist. Demo scheduled for 6/23.
- Today: Senta team reported intermittent 503s when ramping to 120 concurrent sessions. Observed error-rate spike correlates with autoscaler cooldowns.
- Root cause hypothesis: Dedicated autoscaler policy (minReplicas=1, burst to 4) + model warmup latency causing request queueing.
- Immediate mitigation: increased minReplicas to 2 for their pool (temporary), added health-check smoothing. Rahul applied change at 09:30 PT — metrics look stable but still watching.
- Tickets: JIRA RG-1243 created to track autoscaler tuning and a follow-up perf test.
- Next steps: run controlled load test 6/18 with Mateo (solutions) + Senta infra; confirm 99th latency <= 750ms. Action: Mateo to own test run.

2) Lumina (SaaS analytics) — hosted API -> Dedicated migration
- Migration plan in progress. Completed data plane VPC peering but initial deploy failed due to checksum mismatch on model artifact fetch.
- Root cause: their S3 replication to dedicated bucket had eventual consistency edge-case; we added retry/backoff in artifact fetcher.
- Workaround: manual rsync and integrity check completed 6/15.
- Impact: two-day delay to cutover window. Customer accepts new schedule (cutover 6/22).
- Linked PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/3421 (artifact-fetcher retry) — Priya to follow up on rollout schedule.

3) OrionHealth (regulated infra, Private)
- Status: compliance docs signed; onboarding for on-prem installer next week.
- Blocker: their security team wants HSM integration validated. Jinwoo to run HSM test harness with vendor keys on a staging installer (target 6/19).
- Action: Jinwoo will provision test VMs and run the installer; report in Slack #private-deployments.

4) ArcBot (conversational agent startup) — hosted API
- Small regression noticed in token pricing on July estimate report; finance flagged cost delta.
- Investigation: Redwood Optimize suggested new batching profile pushed in stage which increased per-token throughput but changed request distribution; results in more tokens billed per session for certain prompts.
- Action: Asha to coordinate with Optimize team to revert batching profile for ArcBot until we finish an eval. Ticket RG-1301 opened.

5) Vega Retail (pilot) — Dedicated + Optimize
- Good progress: latency SLOs met, but KV cache hit-rate lower than expected (35%).
- Hypothesis: tokenization mismatch for product SKUs. Mateo to create prompt normalization pre-step.
- Action: Mateo to deliver normalization patch and run a 24h pilot (owner: Mateo).

Blockers / High priority issues:
- Autoscaler behavior under burst for Dedicated pools (affects Senta + potential others). Need consolidated playbook for autoscaler tuning. (Owner: Rahul; deliverable: autoscaler tuning doc by 6/21).
- HSM validation for Private customers (OrionHealth). Jinwoo to lead vendor test harness.
- Cost/regression from Optimize batching profiles (ArcBot). Coordinate rollback and postmortem (Owner: Asha + Optimize team).

Operations / Actions taken this week:
- Increased minReplicas for Senta pool (temporary).
- Deployed artifact-fetcher retry/backoff to stage; PR queued for prod after smoke tests.
- Created RG-1243 and RG-1301 in Jira for tracking priority items.

Action items (owner — due):
- Mateo: run Senta controlled load test and report results (6/18).
- Rahul: draft autoscaler tuning playbook + recommended defaults for Dedicated pools (6/21).
- Priya: coordinate Lumina cutover and confirm rollback plan (6/20).
- Jinwoo: HSM test harness and staging installer run (6/19).
- Asha: coordinate Optimize rollback for ArcBot and begin postmortem (6/18).
- Mateo: normalization patch for Vega Retail and 24h pilot (6/20).

Risks & notes:
- If autoscaler tuning not standardized, more Dedicated customers may see intermittent 5xx during bursts. Prioritize playbook.
- Private HSM requests will increase as we close more regulated deals; need recurring capacity in SRE to run vendor tests.

Misc / housekeeping:
- Next sync: 2026-06-23 10:00 PT.
- Please update Jira tickets with status before next meeting.
- Slack summary will be posted in #solutions-pro-services after notes reviewed.

Meeting adjourned 10:45 PT.

Notes on doc provenance: informal meeting notes — include action items and owners. Will be archived in Drive under solutions-pro-services weekly notes.
